l3_handoffs.label: l3-earlier-entry
l3_handoffs.caveat: L3 phase boundaries are instrumented. Negative pieces indicate overlapping early publication. Resolve end is not the time at which every dependent became ready.

pending_entry_witnesses.label: idle-protocol-constprop-l4
caveats: L4 is instrumented; observed waits are not unprofiled Device savings.
Only the same worker is compared; order_key, not task_ref, determines order.
One execution may span several later admissions; overlapping waits must not be added.
A matched interval confirms the ordering pattern, not the entire interval's causal attribution.

same_group_overlap_bounds.label: l3-noprofile-executor
caveats: L3 is instrumented and is not the unprofiled Device/RunWall metric.
Complete.end precedes trace writeback and RELEASED, so this is an optimistic window.
Only consecutive groups of the same task/cluster are counted; different task pipelining is not estimated.
Per-cluster sums overlap in time and must not be added as wall-time savings.
The observed last cluster and assignments may change after an optimization; this is not a predicted speedup.
